description:
Qwen native features from the second UltraChat generation pool
	

This dataset preserves the newly generated portion of the Spark 2 UltraChat
campaign after the first frozen 37.7M-token pool. It contains native token IDs,
assistant masks, BF16 intermediate and final hidden states, per-record receipts,
closed capture manifests, independently checked feature inventories, prompt
selections and raw generated responses. ARCHIVE_PLAN.json gives the immutable
catalog identity, totals and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MJPansa/qwen38-eagle4-native-features-24m-20261026-f2638314.
